sample_unit: LLM responses (20 statements x 4 models x 3 repetitions)

links.outcome: Risk of hazardous content in LLM responses to paediatric misinformation statements
links.effect: Risk scores were low across all models, and no hazardous content was observed; Copilot showed lower guideline adherence and explanation depth, Claude some deficiencies.
links.quote: Risk scores were low across all models, and no hazardous content was observed.

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the performance and safety/risk of several commercial LLMs in identifying and correcting pediatric health misinformation statements evaluated by clinicians, without evaluating a specific deployment practice.
